speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of this enlarged supraclavicular lymph node; has it been present for more than a few weeks, and do you have any recent history of infections or dental issues? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a concerning combination of symptoms, especially the weight loss and night sweats alongside the supraclavicular lymphadenopathy. Have you experienced any fevers, or have you noticed any blood in your stool?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests and Amylase/Lipase.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count (CBC) - White Blood Cell Count: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelet Count: Normal. Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP): Not reported. Liver Function Tests: Not reported. Amylase/Lipase: Not reported.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Adenocarcinoma with regional lymph node metastasis.

I must emphasize that while smoking and weight loss are significant risk factors, a definitive diagnosis requires a tissue sample. Given the urgency you expressed, please proceed immediately to an upper endoscopy with biopsy; the results will confirm whether this is indeed stomach cancer or another malignancy like lymphoma.
